categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Play audio content such as a song, album, artist, genre, or playlist on a specific platform or generally.

categories.name: Add Music to Playlist
categories.definition: Add a specific music track, artist, or album to a user-defined playlist.

categories.name: Get Weather Information
categories.definition: Inquire about current or future weather conditions, forecasts, or specific weather phenomena for a given location and time.

categories.name: Get Media Showtimes
categories.definition: Request information about the screening times and locations for a specific movie or type of movie.

categories.name: Get Media Schedule
categories.definition: Request a general list or overview of movies or TV shows currently playing or scheduled.

categories.name: Find Media Content
categories.definition: Locate a specific movie, TV show, saga, or trailer for viewing or information.

categories.name: Get Media Information
categories.definition: Request details about a movie, TV show, or other media, such as genre or publisher.

categories.name: Rate Content
categories.definition: Provide a rating or review for a specific piece of content such as a book, album, or movie.

categories.name: Book Restaurant/Reservation
categories.definition: Make a reservation at a dining establishment or inquire about availability.

categories.name: Find Other Content/Product
categories.definition: Locate a specific non-media item such as a book, video game, photograph, or product.
